final: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), first_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS baseline FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT t.avg_pulse_rate, b.baseline AS first_baseline FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS b WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > b.baseline), second_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS baseline FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - k.first_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - b.baseline) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN second_baseline AS b WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > b.baseline
